title: Queensland should join automatic mutual recognition
action: Join the national scheme so that workers licensed in other states can work in Queensland without applying for a new licence, and Queensland workers can work interstate the same way.
why: Queensland is the only state outside the scheme, so tradespeople and professionals still face paperwork and fees to cross its border, which slows the response to skill shortages and disaster rebuilding.

evidence.source: Housing construction productivity: Can we fix it?
evidence.quote: Queensland is not currently participating in the scheme (DEWR 2024a).

evidence.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
evidence.quote: Pursue automatic mutual recognition to help overcome NSW skills shortages.

precedents.what: Every other state and territory joined between 2021 and 2022.
